## Findings

- VS Code lists every skill twice when it lives in `.github/skills/` with a `.claude/skills/` symlink, because it reads both folders; `chat.agentSkillsLocations` with `".claude/skills": false` in the workspace settings did not hide the second copy.
- A mistaken `/sl-ds-feedback 3728` picked from that list was handled safely: the skill saw the issue exists, offered only a 👍 and posted nothing.
